content.title: Brazil's BRF expects China, Europe to resume chicken imports
content.summary: SAO PAULO (Reuters) -China and Europe will resume buying chicken products from Brazil "in a matter of days or weeks" as local authorities controlled a bird flu outbreak that triggered trade bans in the second quarter, Brazilian food processor BRF SA said on Friday.  Brazil's first bird flu case at a chicken breeder farm last May sparked a number of trade restrictions that were gradually lifted by importers as the world's largest poultry exporter controlled the outbreak.
